reliefIdentityFinding.question: The route key names both pardon and sealing relief, and the only held source is a pardon application. Which relief does this family deliver, and to which body?
reliefIdentityFinding.answer: An application for EXECUTIVE CLEMENCY — an unconditional pardon with removal of guilt — filed with an AGENCY, not a court. It is not sealing and not expungement.
reliefIdentityFinding.why: The route key's pathway segment `marijuana-specific-summary-pardon-or-sealing-relief` is a disjunctive obligation label covering however a jurisdiction answers that obligation. North Dakota answers it on the pardon branch, and the record says so in four independent places rather than only on the form's title.
recordedBasis: data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json, ND track nd-summary-marijuana-pardon — legalName `Application to Pardon Eligible Marijuana Offences (N.D.C.C. ch. 12-55.1; SFN 61663)`; publicName `Apply for North Dakota's summary marijuana pardon`; venue `No court venue. The application goes to the Pardon Advisory Board through the pardon clerk.`; destination.kind `agency`, destination.name `Clerk, Pardon Advisory Board, North Dakota Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation`. Its mechanism states in terms that `the form warns in terms that a pardon request will not expunge a criminal history record`.

data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json — the same single official_pdf_fill component on SFN-61663, with attachment_instructions and deadline_instructions as process_guidance. Consistent with the registry; no sealing component anywhere in the set.

data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/ND.memo.json, track nd-summary-marijuana-pardon — nodeType `supporting_action`, not a relief track. legalDesignDecision.rationale: `It is a supporting action rather than a relief track because it clears no record itself; it produces the unconditional pardon that is the eligibility ground for the pardoned-conviction seal.` A packet_instruction limitation states `A pardon will not expunge a criminal history record`, citing N.D.C.C. § 12-55.1-01(4).

The source document's own face, read at 300-dpi-equivalent text extraction from the bound bytes. First printed instruction bullet, page 1: `A REQUEST FOR A PARDON WILL NOT EXPUNGE AN INDIVIDUAL'S CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORD.` Page 2 reproduces N.D.C.C. 12-55-1.01(4): `A pardon does not remove the fact of that person's conviction or plea or finding of guilt for an offense unless specifically stated in the certificate of pardon.`
reliefIdentityFinding.theSealingRouteIsADifferentRoute: ND.memo.json lists as a self-help stop condition: `A participant confusing the executive pardon with the court sealing route under N.D.C.C. § 19-03.1-23(9).` The court sealing route is a separate route and is not this family. Any participant-facing copy this family ever ships must lead with the form's own non-expungement warning and must never present itself as sealing or expungement.
otherMaterialFactsOnTheSourceFace: Open Record Notice: on the Department's receipt the application becomes public record, and participation is documented in the Board's published agenda and minutes. This is a participant-facing consequence that belongs in any instructions this family ever ships.
The Board meets in April and November and the form must be received 90 days before the Board convenes.

Items 1 to 4 on the form are certifications and a consent to a criminal-history background check. They are printed text, not widgets, and are attested by the applicant's own signature. Nothing in this lane pre-attested any of them; no fill was performed at all.

blockers.what: finalizeOfficialForm refuses to write onto SFN-61663. detectNonFilingNotice matched the pattern id `informational_purposes_only` against the page-1 footer sentence `This is provided for informational purposes only and not for the purpose of providing legal advice. You should contact your attorney to obtain advice with respect to any particular issue or problem.`
blockers.assessment: Probable false positive, with high confidence.
blockers.reasoning: The matched sentence is a legal-advice disclaimer whose subject is the two advisory notes printed immediately above it — `Open Record Notice:` and `Effect of Pardon with Removal of Guilt:`. It is not the form describing itself as a reference copy. The same page instructs `If you fail to complete this application in full, including the needed attachments, it will be returned to you`, gives three submission channels (fax 701-328-6780, P.O. Box 1898 Bismarck ND 58502-1898, pardonclerk@nd.gov), carries a `Signature of Applicant` widget among 36 fillable widgets, and is the form prescribed under N.D.C.C. 12-55-1.06. The words sample, specimen, draft and `do not file` appear nowhere in the document.
blockers.corroboratedByTheRepoItself: The repo's earlier and narrower detector agrees. NON_FILING_PATTERNS in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-non-filing-notice.mjs is subject-anchored on `THIS FORM IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY` — a claim whose subject is the form. Run against this footer all four of its patterns return false, while it still matches the North Carolina translation notice it was written for. The looser list in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-source-notice.mjs reduced that to the bare substring `for informational purposes only`, dropping the subject anchor. Its own header comment states the intended test as `a document that says any one of them about itself` — the implementation no longer enforces `about itself`.
blockers.whyThisLaneDidNotProceed: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-source-notice.mjs is shared by every official_pdf_fill family and is outside this lane's two assigned paths. The only two ways past the gate from inside this build were to edit that detector — another lane's decision, on a gate that protects real non-filing documents — or to pass finalizeOfficialForm a trimmed documentTextLines, which is withholding evidence from a safety gate to make it pass. Filling a form by suppressing the sentence that stopped the fill is the defect this factory exists to catch, so neither was done.
blockers.suggestedRemedy: Restore the subject anchor on the informational_purposes_only pattern so it matches a document describing itself rather than any legal-advice disclaimer, then re-run this builder unchanged. The census is already clean at 36/36 fields, so the family should build without further work on this script. A repo-wide re-check is worth doing at the same time: any other official form carrying an ordinary legal-advice disclaimer is being held by the same over-match.
blockers.notVerifiedByThisLane: This assessment is this lane's reasoning and evidence. It is not an adjudication, and this lane does not clear its own blocker.
